name: Tilla
dialoguePrompt: Exhaust conversation options to receive reward

name: Tricky Bulle Fruit
dialoguePrompt: Exhaust conversation options to receive reward

name: Aberdeen
dialoguePrompt: I hope you drop that thought...
dialogueResponse: 'Aberdeen:' If that's your thought, you are not exactly "adventurous."

name: Adelinde
dialogueResponse: 'Adelinde:' Haha, you're overthinking things, that's just nonsense.

name: Afshin
dialoguePrompt: It sounds familiar, yet slightly different...
dialogueResponse: 'Afshin:' It sounds like you don't believe me...

name: Agemo
dialoguePrompt: Sounds like a lot of strenuous physical labor.
dialogueResponse: 'Agemo:' Exactly! It's a race against time, day in and day out, to keep the food from going cold and soft.

name: Ahangar
dialogueResponse: 'Ahangar:' Seems like you are pretty confident in your abilities.

name: Aikawa Susumu
dialogueResponse: 'Aikawa Susumu:' Haha, it's nothing like Inazuma, which has oceans surrounding it. Natlan is a country of red-hot passion, both in name and climate.

name: Akeor
dialogueResponse: 'Akeor:' Thank you. Thank you!

name: Allan
dialoguePrompt: Could you tell us about hunting techniques?
dialogueResponse: 'Allan:' Draff is very experienced, and he's taught me a lot, like how to read the wind direction to prevent our prey from catching our scent.

name: Alom
dialogueResponse: 'Alom:' I'm not sure why, but this kind of rhythm helps relieve my fatigue from all the repetitive toil. Really keeps my energy levels up, you know?

name: Amenoma Tougo
dialoguePrompt: The blades aren't exactly the same as the ones in Liyue.
dialogueResponse: 'Amenoma Tougo:' Yeah, the materials and methods used to forge the weapons aren't the same, so the resulting weapons would be of a different style as well.

name: Ami
dialoguePrompt: Just keep your eyes on the pot.
dialogueResponse: 'Ami:' Do I need to keep watching until it's done?

name: Amina
dialogueResponse: 'Amina:' And I'm not just bragging, y'hear? If you come up with any comments or suggestions while having fun here in our land, feel free to tell me any time.

name: Amir
dialogueResponse: 'Amir:' That means a lot to me. Ah, how I wish more kind people like you would join the Forest Rangers.

name: Arakavi
dialogueResponse: 'Arakavi:' It was a song as golden as the sun, and I was proud to be a part of it. As the Golden Nara, you will always stay in my memories and the memory of Vanarana.

name: Arapacati
dialogueResponse: 'Arapacati:' Yes, it will be fine. Aranara are all afraid of fire, except for us brothers and sisters. That's why Arapacati made this pot. With this pot, the fire will be very, very small — not too hot and not too scary.

name: Areta
dialogueResponse: 'Areta:' No, sunshine is needed here.

name: Arezo
dialoguePrompt: To be honest, I'm a little jealous.
dialogueResponse: 'Arezo:' Jealousy won't make you any happier. If you have a dream, take actions and go for it.

name: Ariana
dialogueResponse: 'Ariana:' Yeah. Curry is one thing that everyone in Sumeru knows how to cook.

name: Arouet
dialogueResponse: 'Arouet:' You seem like a sensible person.

name: Ashk
dialoguePrompt: Things might not be as they seem...
dialogueResponse: 'Ashk:' You're right. People can be easily distracted or deceived.

name: Ashpazi
dialogueResponse: 'Ashpazi:' You got a problem with me, pal?

name: Askia
dialogueResponse: 'Askia:' Here, give me your hand.

name: Atiyah
dialogueResponse: 'Atiyah:' ...Well, other than the stuff I mentioned earlier, our food is just the best! If you don't believe me, just try this!

name: Atsuko
dialogueResponse: 'Atsuko:' What's wrong with it? You mean, breaking Inazuman regulations?

name: Avilix
dialoguePrompt: Looks like I'll have to go get some.
dialogueResponse: 'Avilix:' Haha, don't you worry. We're not the type to look down on anyone who doesn't come bedecked in gems.

name: Aybak
dialogueResponse: 'Aybak:' It's okay. It's not an emergency. No need to bother anyone else.

name: Azra
dialogueResponse: 'Azra:' Just like water!

name: Baishi
dialogueResponse: 'Baishi:' You worship her? In what way? Intellectually? Spiritually? Or...

name: Baiwen
dialogueResponse: 'Baiwen:' Many people do, including myself.

name: Baixiao
dialoguePrompt: I have the utmost respect for Lady Ningguang.
dialogueResponse: 'Baixiao:' Hmm... You are, indeed, a rare and honest sort — cut from a different cloth from those honey-tongued merchants, greedy for the smallest scrap of information.

name: Balam
dialogueResponse: 'Balam:' Do they, then? Well, guess there's no choice in the matter. I suppose we'll have to just compromise on one item here, then?

name: Banka
dialogueResponse: 'Banka:' Hehe, I know it's just a polite gesture, but it's still comforting.

name: Bayajidda
dialoguePrompt: I'll swing by when I'm free.
dialogueResponse: 'Bayajidda:' Thanks!

name: Behaim
dialoguePrompt: May the Anemo Archon bless you!
dialogueResponse: 'Behaim:' Yes, yes, you are right...

name: Bhai
dialogueResponse: 'Bhai:' When I was young, I used to travel around with the fleet, which taught me to cherish every drop of water and every flower.

name: Biram
dialogueResponse: 'Biram:' Like the fire here, yes.

name: Boileau
dialoguePrompt: Do not treat cases like child's play.
dialogueResponse: 'Boileau:' Yes, you are right.

name: Bolai
dialogueResponse: 'Bolai:' Tsk, look, I know they're not much to look at, but these here Sunsettias hold a profound and mysterious secret...

name: Bran
dialoguePrompt: I'd like a Welfare Meal, please.
dialogueResponse: 'Bran:' Understood.

name: Brook
dialogueResponse: 'Brook:' Haha, of course. This steak was made by me, Brook, after all!

name: Brother Qian
dialoguePrompt: Surely you didn't gain it via fraudulent means?
dialogueResponse: 'Brother Qian:' You're right, I didn't. I've never done anything fraudulent in my life.

name: Bruneau
dialoguePrompt: Can I look around the public area?
dialogueResponse: 'Bruneau:' Hmm... technically, this is an office area, but it is frequented every day by a lot of people who do not work here.

name: Butrus
dialogueResponse: 'Butrus:' Exaggerated? No, no, no!

name: Cadmael
dialogueResponse: 'Cadmael:' Haha, thanks for listening to my rambling. Hope I didn't waste your time.

name: Cairuo
dialogueResponse: 'Cairuo:' Hehe, it does, doesn't it? Here, try some! And if you like 'em, feel free to come back any time!

name: Camac
dialoguePrompt: Can't judge a book by its cover...
dialogueResponse: 'Camac:' Ah, now that you mention it... There's definitely some people who look cute enough, but are real difficult to get along with...

name: Camotli
dialogueResponse: 'Camotli:' Food recommendations... Hmm, you're probably no super hungry yet, are you? How about some Puffed Grainfruit Bars to get those tastebuds going?

name: Carpe Diem
dialogueResponse: 'Carpe Diem:' Blood? ...Ah. If you hadn't mentioned it, I wouldn't have noticed.

name: Cassigneul
dialoguePrompt: I wish you a good day at work.
dialogueResponse: 'Cassigneul:' Thank you. I have every faith that my project here will proceed smoothly. I believe in this harbor and everyone who works here.

name: Cava
dialoguePrompt: Do you need me to tell her?
dialogueResponse: 'Cava:' You know Navia? Awesome!

name: Chan Baatjan
dialogueResponse: 'Chan Baatjan:' It seems you are a fellow seeker and lover of the finest cuisine and daintiest of delicacies as well.

name: Chanca
dialogueResponse: 'Chanca:' Well, I'd go with my personal specialty, Tatacos.

name: Chang the Ninth
dialogueResponse: 'Chang the Ninth:' Haha, I'll take your well-wishes to heart!

name: Chanil
dialoguePrompt: Maybe they've got something they need to work together on.
dialogueResponse: 'Chanil:' Is that so? Well, in that case, should I not stop making a ruckus, and instead wait patiently for their return?

name: Chaonan
dialogueResponse: 'Chaonan:' The problem is my personality... That, and luck not being on my side.

name: Charlene
dialogueResponse: 'Charlene:' Uh huh, why not? Whatever happens, happens. I don't need to worry about something that hasn't even happened yet!

name: Chef Mao
dialogueResponse: 'Chef Mao:' Black-Back Perch Stew is our signature dish. Sure, you might find it in other restaurants too, but I guarantee you it won't taste anywhere near as good as ours.

name: Chen the Sharp
dialoguePrompt: Tell me about the Guhua Clan.
dialogueResponse: 'Chen the Sharp:' Ah, the mere mention of it takes me back. I do wonder what everyone's doing these days, you know, my master and all the others I trained with...

name: Cheriez
dialoguePrompt: I can help to speed him up.
dialogueResponse: 'Cheriez:' It's okay. I don't mean to rush him. It is a good thing to think carefully while making plans for the future and then slowly enjoying the rest of it.

name: Choiseul
dialoguePrompt: Looks like everything's fine at the Institute today.
dialogueResponse: 'Choiseul:' Of course, everything is running smoothly, like clockwork! This is how the New Fontaine Research Institute operates, it's truly incredible!

name: Chubo
dialogueResponse: 'Chubo:' Oh? Outsiders, are you? Hello there, greetings!

name: Chunshui
dialogueResponse: 'Chunshui:' Thank you, and mine to you... If you don't mind, please take this.

name: Cintli
dialogueResponse: 'Cintli:' Haha, is that an attempt to goad me?

name: Cyrus (Mondstadt)
dialoguePrompt: Can you share some adventurer's experience with me?
dialogueResponse: 'Cyrus:' Why, of course. Here, take this. I'm sure it'll be of use to you.

name: Damestier
dialoguePrompt: I spot some people trying to catch Mekafish...
dialogueResponse: 'Damestier:' Oh, that... Technically, that's not fishing, but guiding Mekafish to designated spots with a specialized flashing gadget.

name: Dana
dialogueResponse: 'Dana:' Hearing you say this, I feel a bit more relieved.

name: Daniaud
dialogueResponse: 'Daniaud:' Thank you! I am still new to this, so I only managed to fish out some plants.

name: Darcy
dialogueResponse: 'Darcy:' I actually like living here! When I was outside, I lived a life with my days and nights all topsy turvy, sleepless at night, dispirited and listless during the day...

name: Darina
dialogueResponse: 'Darina:' I haven't been able to dream ever since I grew up, but still, one should dream big.

name: Darya
dialoguePrompt: Did you come up with any solution?
dialogueResponse: 'Darya:' I will have to speak out if the Akademiya continues to cut funding.

name: Debal
dialogueResponse: 'Debal:' What? I'm running a legitimate business here. I don't steal, I don't rob, and I sure don't dupe others out of their fortunes. I work hard and I've earned everything I have through sweat and toil.

name: Demyan
dialoguePrompt: You seem to be in a good mood.
dialogueResponse: 'Demyan:' Haha, thanks! I'm sure that's why my boss sent me here. A duty to fit the man, is what they say.

name: Denichere
dialoguePrompt: You know how to repair meka?
dialogueResponse: 'Denichere:' I used to work in a project team that built meka, but the project leads kept changing.

name: Domon
dialoguePrompt: May your wishes be granted as soon as possible.
dialogueResponse: ;(After completing Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow){{Verify|Unlock condition}}

name: Dongdong
dialoguePrompt: Good luck, you can do it.
dialogueResponse: 'Dongdong:' Thanks! You're one of the few people in the village to encourage me!

name: Dr. Edith
dialogueResponse: 'Dr. Edith:' Isn't it? Her whole life was resistance. This must be the spirit of freedom that runs through Mondstadt.

name: Dr. Livingstone
dialogueResponse: 'Dr. Livingstone:' I certainly am, though I would be the first to admit that my appearance is more that of a scholar... Nevertheless, my principle occupation is indeed adventuring.

name: Draff
dialogueResponse: 'Draff:' Envious? Well, it's fine. I'm in a good mood right now. There's some leftover meat from our daytime delivery. Take it, take it!

name: Ehrnrooth
dialogueResponse: 'Ehrnrooth:' That I am. Since this library was built, Lady Lauma has asked us to shift as much of our book collection in as possible.

name: Ella Musk
dialogueResponse: 'Ella Musk:' Oh, are you interested in these things as well?

name: Ellin
dialogueResponse: 'Ellin:' Thank you. I will definitely make it, just like the Dawn Knight from Ballads of the Squire...

name: Enteka
dialogueResponse: 'Enteka:' Haha, looks like you are a cat lover, too.

name: Erinle
dialogueResponse: 'Erinle:' Good. That's another person persuaded.

name: Esther
dialogueResponse: 'Esther:' Oh, interested in Dragonspine, are you? Interesting. You might have some potential as a geographer...

name: Estienne
dialogueResponse: 'Estienne:' Actually, it's possible for me to just take her straight out of the Fortress, and bring her right to her family... But that would make me the primary culprit in breaking the rules, and I'm not willing to pay the price.

name: Eugenie
dialogueResponse: 'Eugenie:' Yes! This batch of fruits just arrived this morning from Mondstadt. They are really sweet! Feel free to try some! If it's delicious, please come again!

name: Everallin
dialogueResponse: 'Everallin:' To be honest, I am not sure if my understanding of the sea's depth is the same as that which human beings sense.

name: Eymen
dialogueResponse: 'Eymen:' And... And... I just managed to collect some "fine wine" every now and then for the business of the restaurant.

name: Farbod
dialogueResponse: 'Farbod:' Rukkhashava Mushrooms are great stuff! You know by the name that they must be something amazing left by Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

name: Farooq
dialoguePrompt: You all look pretty much the same...
dialogueResponse: 'Farooq:' That's even easier: Don't trust anyone.

name: Farrah
dialogueResponse: 'Farrah:' *sigh* Thank you for that.

name: Fengyan
dialogueResponse: 'Fengyan:' It's just a title. All it means is that I had more of a knack than my comrades for unarmed combat, so I was tasked with teaching martial arts to the new recruits.

name: Flora

rewards.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea

dialoguePrompt: Why do you like Dandelions so much?
dialogueResponse: 'Flora:' Hehe, I wonder... Maybe it's because I've been reading The Fox in the Dandelion Sea.

name: Freycinet
dialogueResponse: 'Freycinet:' Hehe...

name: Frith
dialogueResponse: 'Frith:' I'm just an ordinary restaurant owner, nothing special.

name: Furat
dialogueResponse: 'Furat:' Good! Looking forward to hearing from you then.

name: Furuta
dialoguePrompt: You must've been very skilled before.
dialogueResponse: 'Furuta:' Hahaha, you praise me excessively. Right now, I'm nothing more than a servant of the Kamisato Clan. At best, I had some experience when I was still young...

name: Furuya Noboru
dialoguePrompt: I look forward to working with you.
dialogueResponse: 'Furuya Noboru:' Seeing as you've just arrived, I'll share with you some of the experiences that I've gathered over the years.

name: Gaiman
dialoguePrompt: So, tell me about the Guhua Clan.
dialogueResponse: 'Gaiman:' Well, it was once a flourishing organization in Liyue. Back then, they were even called the Guhua Brotherhood.

name: Galathee
dialogueResponse: 'Galathee:' Yes, my friend, precisely.

name: Galvana
dialoguePrompt: There's someone who looks just like you...
dialogueResponse: 'Galvana:' You've met Galvaryet? She's my younger sister. We're twins. *ahem* She's too old to keep calling me Sis all the time...

name: Gaston
dialogueResponse: 'Gaston:' You're right!

name: Genna
dialogueResponse: 'Genna:' Ah... well. My assignment away from home is almost over, and our wedding anniversary is coming up.

name: Geri
dialoguePrompt: So what are you gonna eat while you're in Liyue?
dialogueResponse: 'Geri:' Well, luckily my sister and I both know enough about cooking that we won't go hungry...

name: Godwin
dialogueResponse: 'Godwin:' So far, I've taken care of quite a few hilichurls and slimes, but there's always more of them...

name: Grace
dialoguePrompt: About those unsettling omens I keep seeing...
dialogueResponse: 'Grace:' No matter what the cause may be, all we can do is pray.

name: Granny Ruoxin
dialoguePrompt: I hope you will be reunited.
dialogueResponse: 'Granny Ruoxin:' Thank you, kind child. Your words bring comfort.

name: Grigory
dialoguePrompt: Can I put it on my tab?
dialogueResponse: 'Grigory:' Haha, come now, dear customer, you hardly look poor. And besides, small outfits like ours need to run tight budgets, you know...

name: Gulabgir
dialoguePrompt: The Forest Watchers might have a problem with that.
dialogueResponse: 'Gulabgir:' Th—They can't know it, for sure!

name: Hajime
dialogueResponse: 'Hajime:' *sigh* You said it... It'd be bad if my master hears me complaining. If he overhears, he'll lecture me for the entire day.

name: Hanfeng, "Cold Blade
locationText: Hanfeng's location (Daytime) Additional context (Daytime) Hanfeng's location (Nighttime) Additional context (Nighttime)
dialoguePrompt: Exhaust conversation options to receive reward

name: Hannelore
dialogueResponse: 'Hannelore:' I'm listening to the sound of wind... and the voices of the people.

name: Harrison
dialogueResponse: 'Harrison:' *sigh*... Sincerity is a key part of doing business, is it not? Just treat it as a gift from a friend.

name: Harry
dialoguePrompt: What kind of help do you provide?
dialogueResponse: 'Harry:' For regular citizens, I help escort them safely to the city, to Springvale, or wherever.

name: Hasegawa
dialoguePrompt: It seems like you are very knowledgeable.
dialogueResponse: 'Hasegawa:' Heh, with my family background, traveling abroad was a simple matter.

name: Hatim
dialogueResponse: 'Hatim:' Oh relax! With my considerable wealth, I'm sure I won't easily go broke.

name: Heinry
dialogueResponse: 'Heinry:' If you're thirsty, drink Fonta! Take this bottle, please, and enjoy its refreshing taste!

name: Herman
dialogueResponse: 'Herman:' Huh, have you... never heard of the adventurer Herman before?

name: Hiia
dialoguePrompt: I got hungry the moment I stopped...
dialogueResponse: 'Hiia:' Hehe. That's quite common, I assure you.

name: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogueResponse: 'Hiiragi Chisato:' You don't have to be polite. Who knows... Maybe I'll need your help in the future.

name: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogueResponse: 'Hopkins the Marvelous:' Huh, you find that expensive?

name: Hoturoa
dialogueResponse: 'Hoturoa:' O—Oh, don't worry, I'm not! The whole point of a goal you set yourself is to put in the effort to achieve it, right?

name: Housein
dialogueResponse: 'Housein:' Really?

name: Huangshan
dialogueResponse: 'Huangshan:' You just need to know that it's a term specific to Liyue that refers to mercenaries who specialize in protecting cargo.

name: Hugues
dialoguePrompt: Alright, such an innovative spirit should be praised.
dialogueResponse: 'Hugues:' I doubt this is a compliment.

name: Hypermarket
dialoguePrompt: As I thought, your branding is a sham...
dialogueResponse: 'Hypermarket:' T—This... I can't lose my branding just because of you...

name: Iaune
dialoguePrompt: That's a pretty good idea, actually.
dialogueResponse: 'Iaune:' Yes. But walking the walk isn't as easy as talking the talk...

name: Ikeda Soushirou
dialogueResponse: 'Ikeda Soushirou:' That's it... To grow taller, you need to listen to the advice of your elders.

name: Iknal
dialogueResponse: 'Iknal:' Not bad. A concise name, yet filled with ambition. That's a good principle...

name: Ikuhara Gai
dialogueResponse: 'Ikuhara Gai:' Thank you for your kind words. I won't give up.

name: Ina
dialogueResponse: 'Ina:' Hey there, {{Traveler}}! We're... uh, on an outing!

name: Inagi Hotomi
dialoguePrompt: Could you tell me about Hanachirusato...

name: Iotham
dialogueResponse: 'Iotham:' Thank you, {{Traveler}}! I want to be a great person just like you, and help those in need just as Rana and you did for me!

name: Ipora
dialogueResponse: 'Ipora:' Got it. I'll soak for a while longer then head back.

name: Iris (Dragonspine Adventurer Camp)
dialogueResponse: 'Iris:' I would strongly caution against venturing into these parts on a whim.

name: Iris (Sumeru City)
dialogueResponse: 'Iris:' Tell me about it. By the time he comes up with a solution, my sisters and I might have already finished our researchers.

name: Iron Ingot
dialoguePrompt: You're not talking about the constellations, are you?
dialogueResponse: 'Iron Ingot:' Hey, cut that out! Can't you see I'm watching the... uh, stars, very intently!?

name: Isadora
dialogueResponse: 'Isadora:' No, it's okay. It is good enough to chat under such a serene night sky. Thank you.

name: Isak
dialogueResponse: 'Isak:' Alright!

name: Ivanovich
dialogueResponse: 'Ivanovich:' You too? Aha, so it's not just me, after all...

name: Izem
dialoguePrompt: It's actually a good thing to retire.
dialogueResponse: 'Izem:' Yeah, I've come to realize that lately.

name: Jabari
dialoguePrompt: I'm alright, but my companion might be hungry.
dialogueResponse: 'Jabari:' Ah yes, I can see how that might become a problem.

name: Jafar
dialogueResponse: 'Jafar:' *sigh* I know, I know. But I just can't see myself spending my whole life on research.

name: Jary
dialoguePrompt: Exhaust conversation options to receive reward

name: Javad
dialogueResponse: 'Javad:' I appreciate your kindness, but life has to go on.

name: Jehiet
dialoguePrompt: I'm sure Iotham will grow up, healthy and strong.
dialogueResponse: 'Jehiet:' Thank you, little guest. Iotham has told me so much about you. He admires you a lot!

name: Jiangxue
dialogueResponse: 'Jiangxue:' No, you misunderstand. I don't fish for a living.

name: Jifang
dialogueResponse: 'Jifang:' You seem like you could handle it. See what you think of this one: Records of Jueyun - Stone Beasts.

name: Jill
dialogueResponse: 'Jill:' Crabs, obviously. Don't you think it's cute, how they walk sideways?

name: Jiuguan
dialogueResponse: 'Jiuguan:' Hmm, perhaps my words were too formal, and caused you confusion.

name: Joel
dialogueResponse: 'Joel:' Thanks... Well, you look like a Traveler. Will be you be going up the mountain to go on more adventures?

name: Jut
dialoguePrompt: I see someone's pretty well connected.
dialogueResponse: 'Jut:' Hehe, you flatter me... It's just that I often sent gifts to my guests when I first started out, so they were willing to tell others about my store to help my business.

name: Kabewa
dialoguePrompt: Umm, then what about your research into volcanic history?
dialogueResponse: 'Kabewa:' U—Uh, well, I've... certainly been looking into it! For example, there seems to be some sort of connection between volcanoes and wrestling moves...

name: Kagawa
dialoguePrompt: You're just lazing around, aren't you?
dialogueResponse: 'Kagawa:' Oh, come on, read the room.

name: Kaida Ryouma
dialogueResponse: 'Kaida Ryouma:' Oh, come on, you don't have to be that humble. That said, you are correct to say that this is the result of everyone's ceaseless struggle...

name: Kannek
dialoguePrompt: This must be some important intel.
dialogueResponse: 'Kannek:' Indeed. Sometimes, even a simple "all good" can make a big difference.

name: Kanra
dialogueResponse: 'Kanra:' You are too nice. Thank you.

name: Karpa
dialoguePrompt: I shall keep that in mind.
dialogueResponse: 'Karpa:' Indeed. Natlan may be the nation of war, but conflict is not the goal of everything. May it guide you to true glory.

name: Katya
dialoguePrompt: The staff here look rather young.
dialogueResponse: 'Katya:' Ah, yeah. Most of these children were left to fend for themselves on the streets. I couldn't stand it. That's why I brought them here, so they could at least have some shelter from the elements, and warm food in their bellies.

name: Kavus
dialoguePrompt: Take good care of Sudabeh and Iotham.
dialogueResponse: 'Kavus:' I will. I'm gonna be a good big brother, and I'll never leave them behind! Otherwise, Rana will criticize me.

name: Kazim
dialogueResponse: 'Kazim:' The longer I work at this job, the more I come to think that everything should be planned out in advance, with contingencies to match.

name: Kerih
dialoguePrompt: Hey now, I exercise a ton every day.
dialogueResponse: {{DIcon}} I'll have you know I can send a hilichurl flying with one punch.

name: Kiminami Anna
dialoguePrompt: May your culinary arts become more and more refined.
dialogueResponse: 'Kiminami Anna:' Hee-hee, thanks~

name: Kujou Kamaji
dialoguePrompt: I hope all goes well with you.
dialogueResponse: 'Kujou Kamaji:' Thank you for your blessing. To be honest, I've learned much from you as well.

name: Kukkia
dialogueResponse: 'Kukkia:' In that case, please take this flower. I picked it just now.

name: Kumari
dialogueResponse: 'Kumari:' Then be sure not to miss it! Hope you'll have a chance to enjoy Nilou's dance and try the best sweets!

name: Kumi
dialogueResponse: 'Kumi:' I feel the same way. Thank you for your help previously.

name: Kurisu
dialogueResponse: 'Kurisu:' Haha. There might be a few tricky problems here and there, but I get a boost of determination seeing everyone's smiling faces after the problem has been resolved.

name: Kuroda

rewards.name: "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?" Limited Deluxe Edition
"Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power," First Edition

dialogueResponse: 'Kuroda:' You won't find either of them on the open market, and certainly not in storage. Every copy was snapped up long ago.

name: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogueResponse: 'Kurosawa Kyounosuke:' If you put it like that, then... I'll try my best.

name: Kuzmichev
dialogueResponse: 'Kuzmichev:' I'm checking the furnace temperature. You've got to nail down those details... even small differences can affect material strength.

name: Lambad
dialogueResponse: 'Lambad:' Of course! The fish was fresh from the water and the pitas just popped out of the oven. Here. Be careful, it's hot!

name: Lan
dialogueResponse: 'Lan:' You think so? Well, I don't do it for any kind of praise or approval.

name: Lastan
dialoguePrompt: Maybe there really was no other way.
dialogueResponse: 'Lastan:' True. They've all tried delivering it themselves, and you saw what happened.

name: Lawaia
dialogueResponse: 'Lawaia:' Absolutely. My nose is sharp enough to tell the difference between today's catch and yesterday's catch, as well as tell fresh customers apart from overnight people.

name: Leonore
dialogueResponse: 'Leonore:' Well... To be more specific, it comes down to two of our core capabilities...

name: Liath
dialogueResponse: 'Liath:' We work with human beings to protect Fontaine — such is the mission entrusted to us by Monsieur Neuvillette.

name: Linlang
dialogueResponse: 'Linlang:' Well, take this chunk of rock, for example. Looks perfectly ordinary, but in fact it came from a star.

name: Little Liu
dialoguePrompt: You can go on adventures without a Vision.
dialogueResponse: 'Little Liu:' You mean be one of those martial arts heroes? Hmph, no thank you!

name: Little Zuo
dialogueResponse: 'Little Zuo:' Thank you! Frogs are super hard to catch, though...

name: Lorgar
dialogueResponse: 'Lorgar:' It's not looking too good... The hilichurls have been increasingly active recently, it's becoming quite a headache.

name: Louis
dialogueResponse: 'Louis:' Heh. Dear, let me pack this up for you. You'll know it once you take a bite.

name: Luca
dialoguePrompt: Exhaust conversation options to receive reward

name: Lynn
dialoguePrompt: What if you can't find ingredients?
dialogueResponse: 'Lynn:' Haha, it's at moments like these that you'll need the Teyvat Wilderness Survivalist's Recipes!

name: Lyulka
dialoguePrompt: What are you doing at the moment?
dialogueResponse: 'Lyulka:' Huh? Well, oh, nothing. Just wondering about some new uses for kuuvahki. Like, if we could upgrade this forging machine with it...

name: Lyylikki
dialogueResponse: 'Lyylikki:' I'm sure it is! The pure moonlight will cleanse all... This too is Lady {{Rubi|Kuutar's|Moon Maiden}} will.

name: Madame Ping
dialogueResponse: 'Madame Ping:' Hehe, all thanks to the beautiful weather we're having today.

name: Mahina Nui
dialoguePrompt: Wouldn't be bad to drink it on a regular basis, either.
dialogueResponse: 'Mahina Nui:' Ah, yeah, good point!

name: Maile
dialogueResponse: 'Maile:' Haha, you're the patient sort, huh? Good. That kinda temperament will make you lots of friends.

name: Maki
dialogueResponse: 'Maki:' ...Forever may the Electro Archon reign.

name: Mandana
dialogueResponse: 'Mandana:' Thanks, I'll take it as a compliment on the good job I did for the garden.

name: Manie
dialogueResponse: 'Manie:' I've been asked this question by lots of people.

name: Mansur
dialogueResponse: 'Mansur:' Oh please...

name: Margaret
dialoguePrompt: Tell me, has there been anything happening as of recent?
dialogueResponse: 'Margaret:' There have. Recently, the Angel's Share has been giving out complimentary Chicken-Mushroom Skewers, and we've been running a promotion response.

name: Marla
dialogueResponse: 'Marla:' Hmm... Well, it's because I can only meet with my lover at night.

name: Maryam
dialoguePrompt: Thank you for your kind reminder.
dialogueResponse: 'Maryam:' Think nothing of it.

name: Master Qin "Thunder Hand
locationText: Before completing Transient Dreams Master Qin's location Additional context After completing Transient Dreams Master Qin's location Additional context
dialoguePrompt: Exhaust conversation options to receive reward

name: Mataoho
dialogueResponse: 'Mataoho:' Hmm? You mean something more stimulating for the skin and muscles? Can't quite imagine that...

name: Matsumoto
dialoguePrompt: What kind of dishes are you looking for?
dialogueResponse: 'Matsumoto:' Simpler dishes do a better job at revealing the chef's true mastery over the culinary arts.

name: Mengmeng
dialoguePrompt: It might be bad to pick so many flowers...
dialogueResponse: 'Mengmeng:' Ah, I'm sorry, I did a bad thing.

name: Menthe
dialoguePrompt: It's never too late to start.
dialogueResponse: 'Menthe:' Whoa, spoken just like Monsieur Neuvillette. It's just that with my hands and eyes, there's a lot of human work that I can't do...

name: Mequignon
dialoguePrompt: Is collecting a hobby of yours?
dialogueResponse: 'Mequignon:' Yes, it's also a way of seeking design inspiration.

name: Michelle
dialogueResponse: 'Michelle:' Yes, actually, but it isn't a serious matter... Well, do you know about Philanemo Mushrooms?

name: Michica
dialoguePrompt: Alright... Would you sell to me, then?
dialogueResponse: 'Michica:' ...No, I'm not asking you to repeat everything.

name: Mirai
dialogueResponse: 'Mirai:' Mm-hmm, thanks! You really remind me of my brother. He's always reminding me to do stuff too, hehe.

name: Mirsky
dialoguePrompt: Are you... a member of the Frostmoon Scions?
dialogueResponse: 'Mirsky:' Nope. Not before, and not now. In the future... Maybe. Maybe not.

name: Miss Bu
dialogueResponse: 'Miss Bu:' Why, experience would be a better teacher than I, wouldn't you say?

name: Mochizuki
dialogueResponse: 'Mochizuki:' Hah... That's good.

name: Momoko
dialoguePrompt: I hope that you'll meet again soon.
dialogueResponse: 'Momoko:' I hope so too.

name: Mozhgan
dialogueResponse: 'Mozhgan:' Well... in my experience, it'll help at least a little bit.

name: Ms. Bai
dialogueResponse: 'Ms. Bai:' Thanks, it's always nice to get positive feedback. This is more than just a mill— the tofu we make here is the best in all of Liyue!

name: Muirne
dialogueResponse: 'Muirne:' Now that we're talking about food, let me give this to you. Take it and you won't need to worry anymore.

name: Mutota
dialogueResponse: 'Mutota:' Don't mention it.

name: Nabati
dialogueResponse: 'Nabati:' Thanks for your encouragement. Knowing that there are still people who share my thoughts raises my confidence again.

name: Nagaoka Hidemitsu
dialogueResponse: 'Nagaoka Hidemitsu:' Inazuma has undergone so many changes in such a short time. In my experience, Her Excellency will not just stand idly by.

name: Najia
dialogueResponse: 'Najia:' If only I could be as open-minded as you are.

name: Nakano
dialogueResponse: 'Nakano:' Ahh, it seems like you still have unfulfilled wishes, young Traveler.

name: Nanako
dialogueResponse: ;(After completing Omnipresence Over Mortals){{verify}}<!--This isn't available immediately after completing "A Swordmaster's Path Is Paved With Broken Blades". It becomes available after completing "Omnipresence Over Mortals". However, the trigger can probably be earlier-->

name: Nanse
dialogueResponse: 'Nanse:' Aye. Speaking of which, I can't use all the mushrooms he gave me before, so I've still got some left... Take these, please. They're quality.

name: Nasir
dialogueResponse: 'Nasir:' Probably. He does sometimes say "I'm not an idler, buddy." Then he would deal with the affairs of the hotel business.

name: Navayi
dialoguePrompt: I'll leave you to your thoughts...
dialogueResponse: 'Navayi:' It's okay. Thoughts are supposed to be exchanged through communications, no?

name: Nawaz
dialoguePrompt: Make sure to be friendly to others.
dialogueResponse: 'Nawaz:' Yeah, that's what I think, too!

name: Nayab
dialogueResponse: 'Nayab:' You think so, too? Then you should come to Puspa Café more often. It has people fighting tooth and nail every day!

name: Nesmil
dialogueResponse: 'Nesmil:' Shh, quiet, don't let her hear you!

name: Ngahue
dialoguePrompt: Let's leave the path ahead to fate...
dialogueResponse: 'Ngahue:' Indeed! Well said! Now that sounds like something the Masters of the Night-Wind might say!

name: Nigina
dialogueResponse: 'Nigina:' Right, you're right. I trust them to take care of themselves.

name: Nishikino Reirei
dialogueResponse: 'Nishikino Reirei:' Huh? Wh—What are you saying all of a sudden?

name: Nobumori
dialoguePrompt: You've crossed blades with Kamisato Ayato...
dialogueResponse: 'Nobumori:' *sigh* That was my youthful ignorance... Please forget about it.

name: Nour
dialogueResponse: 'Nour:' It's a lot easier if we don't need to deal with any danger directly.

name: Obata
dialogueResponse: 'Obata:' Yeah! Do you hear it? The sound of the waves crashing against the beaches, the sound of fishes swimming through the waves...

name: Okazaki Rikuto
dialogueResponse: 'Okazaki Rikuto:' That's because you are still young.

name: Okin
dialogueResponse: 'Okin:' Haha, I'm fine. An ordinary gal like me doesn't need much to be happy with her lot in life.

name: Orban
dialogueResponse: 'Orban:'  I've tried forging weapons from all kinds of materials. But each and every one of them has turned out to be completely unexceptional.

name: Orqo
dialogueResponse: 'Orqo:' Mmm... It's still hidden. Sometimes I can't help but think it's just keeping really, really calm. Still, it doesn't matter. I've got a long list of places I haven't been to yet!

name: Ottnit
dialogueResponse: 'Ottnit:' Hoho, Since your praise is well deserved, I'm very happy to accept it.

name: Paban
dialogueResponse: 'Paban:' Something wrong? I doubt it.

name: Pacal
dialogueResponse: 'Pacal:' Hey, come on, what's with all that politeness? We actually really like making friends with outsiders, you know.

name: Pacha
dialogueResponse: 'Pacha:' Oho, well said.

name: Pakaa Nui
dialoguePrompt: You have a sharp mind for business.
dialogueResponse: 'Pakaa Nui:' Haha, well, a store whose objective is to do its utmost to satisfy the customer's needs can't do too badly, right?

name: Pan Guan'er
dialoguePrompt: So, have you found the adepti?
dialogueResponse: 'Pan Guan'er:' Not yet. No adeptus has come to give me back my axe, either. How strange...

name: Parisa
dialogueResponse: 'Parisa:' True. With knowledge, you can live a better life.

name: Patchi the Curious
dialogueResponse: 'Patchi the Curious:' Why do I research ancient ruins? Out of curiosity, naturally! Surely you find the tantalizing traces of history inside irresistible too?

name: Patton
dialoguePrompt: Do you have any specials these days?
dialogueResponse: 'Patton:' Currently, we're giving every customer a free Chicken-Mushroom Skewer. It goes great with any drink!

name: Plessia
dialogueResponse: 'Plessia:' Yes, and I never conceal my love for them.

name: Potier
dialogueResponse: 'Potier:' Thank you for your support! Parting is inevitable, but may my song accompany you on this beautiful day in Fontaine.

name: Qian
dialogueResponse: 'Qian:' What are you trying to say? ...You're not going to turn me in to the Millelith, are you?

name: Qinglian (Stone Gate)
dialoguePrompt: The two of you really work very hard.
dialogueResponse: 'Qinglian:' It's true, but right now, my body no longer requires that many herbs - what I need is my husband by my side.

name: Qiuyue
dialoguePrompt: I've seen the Rite of Parting...
dialogueResponse: 'Qiuyue:' Wow! So you are the rumored foreign Traveler that assisted with the Rite of Parting!

name: Qushji
dialogueResponse: 'Qushji:' Thanks for your concern.

name: Rahetar
dialogueResponse: 'Rahetar:' F—Familiar?! H—How could I possibly be familiar with such an absurd thing?

name: Railah
dialoguePrompt: Sounds reasonable but doesn't quite make sense in the meantime.
dialogueResponse: 'Railah:' Hahaha, that means you have reached the threshold of wisdom.

name: Raimondo
dialoguePrompt: How are the Institute's research projects going?
dialogueResponse: 'Raimondo:' Some projects were restarted, some have been suspended, some of the researchers have returned to duty, some were furloughed...

name: Rama
dialogueResponse: 'Rama:' Of course!

name: Remande
dialogueResponse: 'Remande:' Of course it does! If you are interested as well, you are welcome to join us aquabus enthusiasts.

name: Roialte
dialogueResponse: 'Roialte:' Well said. It could be a motto.

name: Roya
dialogueResponse: 'Roya:' Just a couple? Just take some, then.

name: Ryouko
dialoguePrompt: You must be very good at cooking?
dialogueResponse: 'Ryouko:' Hehe, this client has a way with words. Even though I'm not famous, I'm confident in my abilities when it comes to the seasoning of Inazuma snacks.

name: Ryuuji
dialogueResponse: 'Ryuuji:' You've probably heard about Inazuma's current situation.

name: Sag
dialoguePrompt: Thank you for taking care of the people here.
dialogueResponse: 'Sag:' Woof!

name: Sal
dialogueResponse: 'Sal:' Thank you.

name: Sandino
dialoguePrompt: You seem like a patient person.
dialogueResponse: 'Sandino:' Hehe, with my age, there is nothing I need to do right away.

name: Sara
dialoguePrompt: Tell me, are there any events happening as of late?
dialogueResponse: 'Sara:' There happens to be a salad tasting event ongoing now.

name: Sayid
dialogueResponse: 'Sayid:' I was reading up on some of Mondstadt's historical myths previously. Fortunately, the library has a wealth of resources for reference.

name: Schulz
dialoguePrompt: How goes your forged blades? Are they worthy of battle?
dialogueResponse: 'Schulz:' I am far from perfecting my craft, but the blades are better than before. They're still not sharp enough, though...

name: Serene
dialogueResponse: 'Serene:' Ah, Mamere told me about the situation. It was the first time that the kid talked that much...

name: Shams
dialogueResponse: 'Shams:'  Yeah, if you've tried to get through the thunderstorm around Inazuma, you must know what I mean.

name: Shana
dialoguePrompt: I'm sure safety still comes into play when grilling fish, right?
dialogueResponse: 'Shana:' Well, you've got me there.

name: Sharp
dialogueResponse: 'Sharp:' Of course. After chasing the monsters away, I have absolutely nothing to do.

name: Shikun

rewards.name: Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup

dialoguePrompt: So how is the pay calculated?
dialogueResponse: 'Shikun:' Nah, it's not, we're way too close to worry about formalities like that!

name: Shirahama
dialoguePrompt: Haha, now I want to try some.
dialogueResponse: 'Shirahama:' Oh, trust me, the texture's super smooth — definitely worth a go!

name: Shirin
dialogueResponse: 'Shirin:' Okay. And on top of common emergency medicine, it's best to have a handy weapon.

name: Shitou
dialoguePrompt: What's the actual probability of finding jade?
dialogueResponse: 'Shitou:' Well, that's the million Mora question isn't it? But seriously, it would ruin the game if I knew the probability in every case. A game of probability is nowhere near as exciting as a game of chance!

name: Shouta
dialogueResponse: 'Shouta:' Wh—What do you want? Are you planning to take these snacks?

name: Sirafi
dialogueResponse: 'Sirafi:' You don't believe me? Well, you should check the quality of my products before you make any judgment.

name: Six-Fingered José
dialoguePrompt: How does one become a bard?
dialogueResponse: 'Six-Fingered José:' Hmm... Well, I became one by trial and error, and a desire to become famous—

name: Soltani
dialogueResponse: 'Soltani:' It's nothing. I was just speaking from experience.

name: Soncoyoc
dialoguePrompt: I heard I could get my hands on some special potions here...
dialogueResponse: 'Soncoyoc:' Pretty well-informed, aren't you? Go on then, tell me what you need.

name: Soraya
dialoguePrompt: How are your travels through Liyue going?
dialogueResponse: 'Soraya:' Great! The ruins and history are fascinating, as are the local customs.

name: Sorimana
dialogueResponse: 'Sorimana:' Hmm... How about this, then? You take these and walk around the wilds a bit more. See if any Saurians crash into— err, I mean, approach you?

name: Stevens
dialoguePrompt: Have you gained anything from your trip so far?
dialogueResponse: 'Stevens:' Ugh, don't get me started. Iris is far too busy, so I've had to scale the mountain myself...  Almost lost my life in the process, never mind finding any ancient texts.

name: Su Er'niang
dialogueResponse: 'Su Er'niang:' There's nothing to worry about, everything's washed thoroughly before I use it.

name: Sudabeh
dialoguePrompt: I'm sure Sudabeh will grow up to be a great distinguished lady!
dialogueResponse: 'Sudabeh:' Thanks, {{Traveler}}! I'm learning really hard! To become a distinguished lady sooner, I'm learning how to cook!

name: Sumac
dialoguePrompt: Maybe everyone was at fault, but not completely.
dialogueResponse: 'Sumac:' It's very hard to say. *sigh* Perhaps I'd be better off if I just stopped thinking about it. Oh, and by the way... Mr. Tenehua came looking for me earlier, so I just told him everything as it was. Would that have helped?

name: Tanamart
dialogueResponse: 'Tanamart:' *sigh* If only my useless husband could think like you...

name: Taraneh
dialoguePrompt: I can teach him a lesson for you.
dialogueResponse: 'Taraneh:' I appreciate your offer, but I'm afraid I'll have to pass.

name: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogueResponse: 'Tea Master Liu Su:' Another one? But I was just getting to the good part in The Wrath of Haishan...

name: Tejima
dialoguePrompt: I hope all goes well with you.
dialogueResponse: 'Tejima:' I hope so too.

name: Tepano
dialogueResponse: 'Tepano:' Very true!

name: Teuciztli
dialoguePrompt: Lawaia told me you're selling fish that were caught yesterday. <small>(If the player asked Lawaia about "An aroma of freshness?" — one-time only)</small>

name: Tezozo
dialogueResponse: 'Tezozo:' Well... I guess you're right!

name: Tia
dialogueResponse: 'Tia:' Yup! This is my first time outside Mondstadt. Everything here is so cool!

name: Timaeus
dialogueResponse: 'Timaeus:' Not too bad, although I haven't had the best of luck recently... My clock is a few minutes too slow, and thanks to that, a whole load of experiments have failed dismally...

name: Tingting
dialogueResponse: {{A|VO Tingting 01.ogg}} "Love or freedom... Which one should I choose?"

name: Tirda
dialoguePrompt: Heroes tend to get a chance to show their stuff.
dialogueResponse: 'Tirda:' By that, do you mean that my singing techniques will come in useful?

name: Tonaca
dialogueResponse: 'Tonaca:' Sure. I'm still a competitive wrestler, after all.

name: Trow
dialogueResponse: 'Trow:' Thank you for the compliment, but you didn't just say that for me to let my guard down, did you?

name: Ulfr
dialogueResponse: 'Ulfr:' Someday, I'll invite Flora to board a dandelion boat that I made myself... It's just a shame that they keep sinking.

name: Umi
dialogueResponse: 'Umi:' Thanks for understanding.

name: Uncle Anpu
dialogueResponse: 'Uncle Anpu:' Good, good, as long as I got through to you.

name: Uncle Tian
dialogueResponse: 'Uncle Tian:' Just a spot of fishing. I don't make my living off of it anymore, though, so when I catch something, I throw it right back in again.

name: Urwa
dialoguePrompt: About the stories you spoke of...
dialogueResponse: 'Urwa:' These are old stories that the desert dwellers are familiar with. Like the adventures of Muzaffar Dey, and the treasure of the evil queen Makhaira. They're very popular with the children.

name: Utsil
dialogueResponse: 'Utsil:' ...I tried to imagine it, and what you said does make sense.

name: Vaneigem
dialogueResponse: 'Vaneigem:' Thank you so much for your appreciation, dear guest. If you don't mind, please accept this sweet treat as a personal thank-you gift.

name: Vasco
dialogueResponse: 'Vasco:' I understand. When you embark on an adventure, you can come across a variety of situations anywhere you go. And rainforests and deserts are infested with quite some strange things.

name: Veleda
dialogueResponse: 'Veleda:' Oh, is that so?

name: Vermeer
dialogueResponse: ;(After completing Luhua Landscape)

name: Victoria
dialoguePrompt: Surely it isn't as simple as that...
dialogueResponse: 'Victoria:' Hmph. Sharp people always make enemies of others.

name: Vimeur
dialoguePrompt: A trial that looks like a performance?
dialogueResponse: 'Vimeur:' It's just a metaphor. Since the Hydro Archon would be present, we usually add some dramatic elements, like those found in plays.

name: Vind
dialogueResponse: 'Vind:' For a majority to live a life of peace, a minority of people must make great sacrifices. My family belongs to this minority.

name: Vinezka
dialoguePrompt: I've already done the job for you.
dialogueResponse: {{Black Screen|You tell Jary about the tunnel being opened on the outskirts of Okurov...}}

name: Wayna
dialoguePrompt: Don't worry about me. I'm pretty amazing.
dialogueResponse: 'Wayna:' Haha, confidence. I like it!

name: Wecksell
dialoguePrompt: Pretty good repair work on this chair.
dialogueResponse: {{DIcon}} Good craftsmanship.

name: Wei Fengchen
dialogueResponse: 'Wei Fengchen:' The way the world is now, martial nomads who perform heroic deeds have grown few and far between, and those who seek justice like myself are fewer still.

name: Wei Xiaobao
dialoguePrompt: You have a sharp mind for business.
dialogueResponse: 'Wei Xiaobao:' Please, you are too kind. It's merely passable, and is nothing compared to Calcagni's eloquence.

name: Wenze
dialoguePrompt: You seem to know a great deal.
dialogueResponse: 'Wenze:' Honestly, it's not much. I've loved history since I was little, and I've always wanted to see these ruins in person. That's why I became an adventurer.

name: Will
dialogueResponse: 'Will:' Yep! The scenery is soooo different from Mondstadt.

name: Wuyuan
dialogueResponse: 'Wuyuan:' Oh, still pretending, are we?

name: Xi'er
dialogueResponse: 'Xi'er:' Exaggerating? I'm just saying the plain old truth.

name: Xiaodong
dialogueResponse: 'Xiaodong:' Thanks, hope it'll work out as we expect.

name: Xona
dialoguePrompt: Why do people from the Collective of Plenty prefer fighting with their bare hands?
dialogueResponse: 'Xona:' Ah, well... That all goes back to our founder.

name: Yantasar
dialoguePrompt: Do we have anything more ordinary around here?
dialogueResponse: 'Yantasar:' ...

name: Yegor
dialogueResponse: 'Yegor:' Say, if I can learn how to cook, would I be able to open a shop with Ryouko?

name: Yevlena
dialoguePrompt: Aren't you afraid I might break something?
dialogueResponse: 'Yevlena:' Of course not. If you break something, you'll have to pay for it, that's all. But if the matter troubles you so...

name: Yikuo
dialoguePrompt: Well, you do have a point.
dialogueResponse: 'Yikuo:' Exactly, right? Life is brutish and short. Working hard every day is fine and all, but is it worth it?

name: Yiqing
dialogueResponse: 'Yiqing:' Heatiness is the root of all evil inside the body, and young people are especially prone to it, for their bodies are easily excited.

name: Ylgr
dialogueResponse: 'Ylgr:' Quite smoothly. I've finished annotating the maps of Drunkard Gorge, Springvale and the surrounding areas...

name: Yoh
dialogueResponse: 'Yoh:' Thank you for the effort that you put in to bring this letter to us. Please accept this charm as a token of gratitude.

name: Yolotli
dialoguePrompt: What if it's a gift given without expecting anything in return?
dialogueResponse: 'Yolotli:' Well... that depends on how much the Iktomisaurus trusts you.

name: Yong'an
dialogueResponse: 'Yong'an:' Come to think of it, I saw a girl trying to give them some milk while I was on morning patrol...ACHOO!

name: Yue Chuan
dialogueResponse: 'Yue Chuan:' Um, not yet. At the moment, all I've found are these crabs.

name: Yuewen
dialoguePrompt: Do you want to settle down?
dialogueResponse: 'Yuewen:' I've been thinking about this, too.

name: Yukio
dialogueResponse: 'Yukio:' I see. You aren't old enough to drink, right? That's also fine. You can order some tea while savoring some of Inazuma's snacks.

name: Yusuf
dialogueResponse: 'Yusuf:' I could eat them every day. You tell me if they're good or not.

name: Yuzu
dialogueResponse: 'Yuzu:' Wah... Thank you...

name: Yvette
dialogueResponse: 'Yvette:' Yes. Perhaps this is how fate is telling me "You're on the right path."

name: Zhang Shun
dialoguePrompt: Tell me about your battle trophies.
dialogueResponse: 'Zhang Shun:' Of all of them, this cup here is probably the one I'll never forget. Brings back memories of my drinking days.

name: Zhonglin
dialoguePrompt: Is there something special about mushrooms from Sumeru?
dialogueResponse: 'Zhonglin:' Oh... I'm not really the right person to ask. I'm no expert in plants.

name: Zhuyu
dialogueResponse: 'Zhuyu:' I'm alright. Picking herbs in the mountains can be quite exhausting. Fortunately, my wife has prepared some berries for me.

name: Ziwei
dialoguePrompt: Isn't it inconvenient to get around at night?
dialogueResponse: 'Ziwei:' That is the case somewhat.

name: Zyryanov
dialoguePrompt: Do you have any ice cream?
dialogueResponse: 'Zyryanov:' You've already had your ice cream for today. Come again tomorrow!
